## One-click end-to-end test
Plays a fake customer through ALL 4 parts and prints PASS/FAIL per check.
1) Set base_url + drivers_chat_id in 'Test Settings'  2) Part 2 must be in demo_mode=true  3) all 4 workflows ACTIVE (production URLs)
Click 'Test workflow'. Enable 'Daily Smoke Test' to run it every morning - a failure then triggers your Error Handler email.
